I'm on the east coast of the US. My ping went from sub 100, usually around 80, to averaging around 130, sometimes spiking up over 200. I don't always notice it but holy crap does this move suck. Why the fuck did they not just centralize it somewhere? When it was on the east coast it sucked for west coast players. Now we have to deal with the shit. They should have put it somewhere in Kansas.

Edit- If you aren't a regular MMO player this may not make sense. So, ping is important for games like this. Let's take a move called Swiftcast. If you use it it allows you to instantly cast your next spell instead of hard casting (or just waiting x amount of seconds that the spell takes to cast). Let's say you are a healer and want to resurrect someone that died. That takes a long time to hard cast it. So, Swiftcast is the best option to do it. You use Swiftcast and it shows active for you. Great right? Not when your ping is spiking over 200. Your use of Swiftcast hasn't been logged server side. So you think you can instacast a ressurection but instead you get stuck hardcasting it and wasting a valuable skill until it resets.

Another problem are aoe attacks by monsters. They are telegraphed on the ground. If your ping is too high you won't see that telegraph until the attack is over, meaning you don't move...meaning you get hit by it. In some cases this can straight kill you, at the very least the rest of your party won't be happy with you always getting hit by shit you should be avoiding.
